name: [SEASON 5] Operations: Siege
desc:
🖥️ Full PC Support
🎮 Full Console Support
⚠️ Mobile Testing Phase

OPERATIONS: SIEGE is an objective-based, 5v5 tactical first-person shooter game. Customize loadouts to your specifications, and use unique operator abilities to secure a victory. Attack or defend the objective, and get the job done in under 3 minutes.

🕹️ Use your gadgets and utilities to gain an advantage on the playing field.
📷 Use cameras to scout the objective and locate your opponents.
🔨 Use breaching tools to destroy walls or floors, and use destruction to win rounds.

Seasonal Updates:
❄️Season 1 "Glacier Night"
🏜️Season 2 "Atlas Lion"
🌸Season 3 "Death's Blossom"
🌲Season 4 "Vantage Point"

This is an active project, and is still being developed. We appreciate all of our supporters, thank you for playing! ❤️
